contaminationControl.notes: The adjustment uses aggregate calibration diagnostics only; no previous predicted scores become team features.

llmOnlyPredictions.rationale: The project already treats LLM reasoning as explanation only. The evaluation does not justify adding an unsourced numeric LLM layer.

monteCarloGroupSimulations.rationale: Conditioning on official completed results is necessary for current standings. Numeric moves remain global and capped because two team-level observations are still sparse.

markovChainScorePredictions.rationale: Exact-score and outcome performance showed the earlier high-scoring near-equal override was too aggressive. Matchday 3 selected scores default to the probability leader unless an alternative is nearly indistinguishable.

changes.explanation: No invented squad, lineup, injury, weather, tactical, xG, or market signal is introduced; LLM remains narrative only.
Simulations should start from official Matchday 1-2 standings and use the same capped global goal/quality calibration as Markov.
The score-selection override is tightened and global goal/quality parameters move only within a small cap.
